career_ladder.note: Assistant Provident Fund Commissioners serve in the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), a statutory social security body under the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India. Officers function as quasi-judicial authorities under the EPF & MP Act, 1952, determining provident fund compliances and supervising regional offices.

exam_scheme.note: UPSC conducts selection for Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner through a two-tier process: a pen-and-paper Recruitment Test (RT, objective type, 300 marks) followed by an Interview (100 marks). The final merit list is drawn giving 75:25 weightage to the marks obtained in the Recruitment Test and the Interview. In the objective Recruitment Test, each incorrect answer carries a penalty of one-third (0.33) marks.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 10 entry basic pay (₹56,100) with 58% Dearness Allowance across major regional office cities (X/Y tiers); net in-hand factors in standard 10% NPS Tier-I contribution and central employee welfare deductions.
official_perks: Leased accommodation / House Rent Allowance (27%/18%/9% by city category)
Official transport or monthly transport allowance with applicable DA
Comprehensive medical coverage under CGHS / EPFO Medical Benefit Scheme
Defined contribution pension benefits under National Pension System (NPS)
Annual Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment provisions

competition_benchmarks.note: APFC is recruited periodically through UPSC Special Advertisements. The most recent recruitment was notified under UPSC Special Advertisement No. 51/2023 (Vacancy No. 23025102725) for 159 posts across categories (UR: 68, EWS: 16, OBC: 38, SC: 25, ST: 12). Over 4.5 lakh applications were reported across combined EPFO exams (EO/AO and APFC).
